visual_elements.description: LEFT PANEL: classic Transformer architecture diagram (Attention Is All You Need style) in a white rectangle with thin black border. Two vertical stacks. RIGHT (decoder) stack top-to-bottom: text 'Output Probabilities'; pale-green rounded box 'Softmax'; lavender rounded box 'Linear'; white box 'Add & Norm'; light-blue box 'Feed Forward'; white box 'Add & Norm'; pale-yellow box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention'; white box 'Add & Norm'. LEFT (encoder) stack, positioned lower, top-to-bottom: white box 'Add & Norm'; light-blue box 'Feed Forward'; white box 'Add & Norm'; pale-yellow box 'Multi-Head Attention'. Label 'Nx' to the left of the encoder stack and to the right of the decoder stack. Curved black connector lines with arrowheads: encoder top output curves right and down into the decoder's 'Masked Multi-Head Attention'; residual skip connections loop around each sub-block; vertical arrows flow upward from bottom to top. Bottom row on both sides: label 'Positional Encoding' next to a circle containing a sine-wave symbol, feeding a circle-plus (⊕) junction; pink box 'Input Embedding' (left) and pink box 'Output Embedding' (right); bottom-most captions 'Inputs' (left) and 'Outputs (shifted right)' (right).

RIGHT PANEL: same Transformer flowchart redrawn in color inside a rectangle with a thick green border. Background split into two zones: left zone pale peach labeled 'Encoder' (red bold italic, top-left corner), right zone pale green labeled 'Decoder' (green bold italic, top-right corner). Identical node sequence to left panel: 'Output Probabilities' text; 'Softmax' (pale green); 'Linear' (lavender); decoder stack 'Add & Norm' / 'Feed Forward' (blue) / 'Add & Norm' / 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (yellow) / 'Add & Norm'; encoder stack 'Add & Norm' / 'Feed Forward' (blue) / 'Add & Norm' / 'Multi-Head Attention' (yellow); 'Nx' beside both stacks; 'Positional Encoding' with sine-wave circle icon and ⊕ junction on both bottom sides; pink 'Input Embedding' and 'Output Embedding'; captions 'Inputs' and 'Outputs (shifted right)'. Two thick red upward arrows: one at bottom below 'Inputs' pointing up into the encoder, one at top just left of 'Output Probabilities' pointing up. Two semi-transparent orange highlight rectangles: one over the encoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' block extending to the left edge of the Encoder zone; one over the decoder's 'Multi-Head Attention' / 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' blocks extending to the right edge of the Decoder zone. A small white mouse cursor [?] is visible over the encoder's Multi-Head Attention block (video artifact).

Large solid red right-pointing block arrow (thick rectangular shaft + triangular head) centered in the gap between the two diagram panels at mid-height, indicating transformation from the plain diagram to the color-coded Encoder/Decoder diagram.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with thin black outline containing the black numeral '4'.

Two semi-transparent orange rectangles overlaid on the right diagram: one spanning the encoder 'Multi-Head Attention' block out to the Encoder zone's left edge; one spanning the decoder 'Multi-Head Attention' and 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' blocks out to the Decoder zone's right edge.
